name: ELM-2311 C-MMR סקטור (נתונים פומביים, טווח משוער)

source_notes.system: ELM-2311 C-MMR — geometry from public data; DETECTION RANGE IS AN ESTIMATE (not published). Conceptual/educational, not a real specification

assumed_not_published.DETECTION RANGE — NOT PUBLISHED: sensitivity calibrated so RCS 0.01 m² -> 35.5 km: midpoint of two C-band weapon-locating radars with published ranges, ARTHUR Mod C (31 km) and COBRA (40 km). An estimate, not a published value
assumed_not_published.range_km=60: weapon-locating instrumented range not published (250 km is an air-surveillance figure); 60 km covers the estimated rocket range
assumed_not_published.vertical 0°-90°: from 'hemispheric view'; the model has one FOV for search and track
assumed_not_published.common (all profiles): MDV 20 kt, M/N 2/3, coast 2 s, aspect RCS 0.005/0.02/0.01 m² (shell), boresight 0 — set it to the threat direction after placing the radar
